description: The full guide as Markdown, the same guide as easeweb.dev/learn/<slug>.md: what happens, why it fails, who it affects, what automation misses, the Before and After code, how to verify, and the limits. Also returns the After code as plain text with its marks (recommended, not enough on its own, the rule of thumb behind it). Takes a guide slug, as listed in find_fix and before_building results.

locale.description: Language of the answer and the guides: en (default) or ja. English answers cite EN 301 549 and Section 508; Japanese answers cite JIS X 8341-3:2016.

name: get_guide
